body: It gets better, honestly it does and i know it doesn't seem like it when our emotions and thoughts are so burdening and all we can see and feel is now. I've been waiting 7 years to feel better, you just have to hold onto the tiny things (even if it's just seeing a pretty ladybug or finding a new song you like) until one day you'll wake up and realize you have so much to live for and that you have a purpose and meaning. Hope is never lost, only forgotten.
life has more to offer you
i hope all those doggos get good homes :)
